notes: Added support for SAST gating with AppScan 360 scan results.
Added support for ingesting and displaying SCA (Software Composition Analysis) scan results.
Added support for ingesting IAST (Interactive Application Security Testing) scan results, with IAST metrics available on the Insights page.
SAST and DAST scan results are fetched from AppScan 360 and displayed as metrics in Velocity using dot indicators.
Fixed an issue with the AppScan360 plugin ID that could cause Loop installation to fail when the AppScan360 integration was enabled before the plugin was installed.
Updated the AppScan360 plugin ID to the correct ucv-ext-appscan360 value for consistency with other Velocity plugins.
